title: Yellow Armor
wikitext:
'''Protection:''' 60% of the damage

'''Yellow Armor''' ('''YA''') is one of three [[Armor|Armors]] found in the game. This will bring your Armor to 150.  It will absorb more damage than [[GA]], but less than [[RA]].

Yellow armor will have an advantage of 50 health points when together with the [[Mega Health]] against a player with [[Red Armor]], which is often a deciding factor in close battles.
